shell.notificationsEmptyBody: You'll hear from us when a post publishes or needs your attention.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.body: We sent a link to {email}. You'll need it to connect your Facebook Page.

home.subtitle: Your account is ready. Here's what you'll be able to do next.

assistant.title: AI Assistant
assistant.subtitle: Ask for a content plan, a post, or a change to your schedule.
assistant.emptyBody: Soon you'll be able to say "plan my next 7 days" and review what it writes, right here.

content.title: Content
content.subtitle: Every post you've drafted, approved or published.
content.emptyBody: Posts you write or generate will be listed here, with their status.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.subtitle: See what goes out, and when.
calendar.emptyBody: Scheduled posts will appear here by day, week or list.

create.title: Create post
create.subtitle: Write it yourself, or let the AI draft it for you.
create.emptyTitle: The composer is on its way
create.emptyBody: You'll write here, add an image, preview how it looks on Facebook and schedule it.

channels.title: Channels
channels.subtitle: The social accounts DPOST publishes to.
channels.emptyBody: Connect a Facebook Page to let DPOST publish for you. Instagram and others come later.

media.title: Media
media.subtitle: Images you upload, and images the AI creates.
media.emptyBody: Uploads and AI-generated images will be collected here, ready to reuse.

brand.title: Brand Brain
brand.subtitle: What the AI knows about your business.
brand.emptyBody: Answer a few questions about your business and DPOST will write in your voice.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: How your published posts performed.
analytics.emptyBody: Once posts go out, you'll see reactions, comments and reach here.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: Published posts, failures and things that need you.
notifications.emptyBody: We'll tell you when a post publishes, or if one needs your attention.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Your account, workspace and preferences.
settings.emptyBody: Account details, workspace preferences and your plan will be managed here.

business.title: Tell us about your business
business.description: DPOST writes as you, not as a chatbot. The more it knows, the less you will have to fix.
business.nameHint: This is the only answer we really need.
business.typeLabel: What kind of business is it?

typeDescriptions.shop: You sell products, online or in a store
typeDescriptions.brand: You make or own a product line
typeDescriptions.creator: You are the face of what you post
typeDescriptions.service: People book your time or skill
typeDescriptions.agency: You work on behalf of other businesses

business.industryHint: Pick from the list or write your own.
business.descriptionLabel: What do you do, in a sentence or two?
business.descriptionHint: Write it the way you would tell a new customer.
business.descriptionPlaceholder: We cook home-style Bangladeshi food to order and deliver across Dhaka the same day.

audience.title: Who are you posting for?
audience.description: Posts written for someone specific always beat posts written for everyone. This is also where the AI learns what you actually sell.
audience.customersHint: Age, work, where they live, what they care about — whatever you know.
audience.customersPlaceholder: Working families in Dhaka who want home-style food without cooking after office.
audience.itemsHint: Press Enter after each one. The AI will never invent a product you did not list.
audience.locationsHint: Areas, cities or countries you deliver to.

voice.title: How should your posts sound?
voice.description: Language matters most here. Bangla, Banglish and English are written differently by DPOST, not translated from one another.

toneDescriptions.friendly: Warm and close, like talking to a regular

voice.languagesLabel: Which languages should DPOST write in?
voice.languagesHint: Pick more than one and posts will be mixed across them.
voice.goalsLabel: What are you hoping to get out of posting?
voice.goalsHint: This shapes the mix of posts, not just their wording.

friendly.label: Friendly
friendly.description: Warm and close, like talking to a regular

voice.frequencyLabel: How often would you like to post?
voice.frequencyHint: You can change this any time, and nothing is published without your approval.
voice.frequencyValue: {count, plural, =1 {1 post a week} other {# posts a week}}

connect.title: Connect your Facebook Page
connect.description: One honest note before you start using DPOST.
connect.statusTitle: Facebook publishing is not ready yet
connect.statusBody: The connection to Facebook Pages is still being built, and Meta has to review our app before it can post on your behalf. Until then DPOST cannot publish anything to your Page.
connect.pointSchedule: When it is ready you will connect your Page here, choose which one, and scheduled posts will go out on their own.
connect.pointMeanwhile: Everything else works now: the AI learns your business, writes posts and keeps them on a calendar for you to copy or approve.

brand.cardSubtitle: This exact text is given to the AI with every request. If a post sounds wrong, the reason is usually here.

business.title: Business
business.description: Who you are and what you do.

contentMix.title: Content plan
contentMix.description: What you post about, and how often.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: Hashtags, call to action and contact details.

memories.title: Memories
memories.subtitle: Rules the AI must follow. Short and specific works best — "never call our food cheap".
memories.empty: Nothing remembered yet. Add a rule and every post will respect it.
memories.addPlaceholder: Friday posts should mention Jummah Mubarak
